title: Do Papaya Leaves Really Raise Platelets in Dengue?
description:
Papaya leaf juice is one of the most common home remedies suggested in India for dengue fever, especially when platelet counts begin to fall. But does papaya leaf extract really cure dengue or raise platelets? In this video, we ask Dr. Abby Philips to explain the science. We break down why platelets fall during dengue infection, how the body naturally recovers, and whether papaya leaves actually have any role in this process.

We look at scientific studies on papaya leaf extract and platelet counts, compare results with other conditions that also cause low platelets, and ask if papaya has shown consistent benefits. We also discuss the difference between uncomplicated and complicated dengue fever, why hospitals don’t rely on folk remedies, and why people continue to believe in papaya leaf cures despite weak evidence.

If you’ve searched for “papaya leaf extract for dengue,” “papaya leaf juice increase platelets,” “does papaya cure dengue,” “natural dengue treatment,” “scientific evidence papaya leaves,” or “alternative medicine dengue fever” this video gives you the rational perspective. Don’t forget to subscribe, like, comment, and share…

07:25 Final verdict: science over superstition

This paper concluded that "current evidence is insufficient to comment on the role of papaya leaf extract in dengue." This is the LATEST, highest-quality evidence paper on Dengue fever and papaya leaf extract use. 
2. Treatment guidelines for Dengue fever from major clinical societies: 
a. World Health Organization: https://www.who.int/news-room/fact-sh... (does not feature papaya leaf) 
b. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention: https://www.cdc.gov/dengue/symptoms/i... (does not feature papaya leaf extract) 
c. UptoDate 2022 Dengue fever treatment: https://www.uptodate.com/contents/den... (does not feature papaya leaf extract) 
d. Updated latest guidelines from National Library of Medicine: https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NB... - specifies that "platelet transfusion is considered when platelet count drops to less than 20,000 cells/microliter, and there is a high risk of bleeding." - no mention of papaya leaf extract. 
3. Low platelets in Dengue fever is due to multiple reasons - one single herbal extract cannot take care of all these causes at a time
